questions.text: What animal is known as the "King of the Jungle"?
What is the national animal of the Philippines?
What insect makes honey?
What animal fights in a sabong?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: gamecock, fighting cock, manok, tandang.

questions.text: What is the fastest land animal?
questions.hostNotes: Not the peregrine falcon, which is fastest overall but flies.

questions.text: What is the tallest animal in the world?
What black-and-white bear from China eats mostly bamboo?
What do you call a baby frog?
What sea creature is called "pawikan" in Filipino?
What orange-and-white fish lives among sea anemones and is the hero of Finding Nemo?
What is the largest land animal?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: elephant. Strictly, it is the African bush elephant.

questions.text: What lizard is famous for changing its skin color?
What tiny primate with huge eyes is a famous attraction in Bohol?
What do you call an animal that eats only plants?
What small wild buffalo is found only on the island of Mindoro?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Bubalus mindorensis. Not the carabao, which is domesticated and found nationwide.

questions.text: What is the largest living bird?
What insect is called "alitaptap" in Filipino?
What is the largest species of big cat?
questions.hostNotes: Not the lion. The Siberian (Amur) tiger is the largest subspecies.

questions.text: What is the only mammal capable of true flight?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: paniki. Flying squirrels and colugos only glide.

questions.text: What word describes animals that are active at night and sleep during the day?
What famously slow mammal spends most of its life hanging upside down in rainforest trees?
What is the process called when a caterpillar transforms into a butterfly?
What egg-laying mammal from Australia has a duck-like bill?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: duck-billed platypus. Echidnas also lay eggs but have no duck bill.

questions.text: Bangus is the Filipino name for what fish?
What do Filipinos call the wild pig?
The bayawak is what kind of large lizard?
What is the largest fish in the world?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: butanding. Not the blue whale, which is a mammal. Donsol, Sorsogon, is famous for whale shark watching.

questions.text: What is the medicine made to treat venomous snake bites called?
The Philippine eagle was once known by what name, after the prey it was believed to favor?
questions.hostNotes: It was renamed the Philippine eagle in 1978 and declared the national bird in 1995.

questions.text: What seagrass-eating marine mammal, nicknamed the "sea cow", lives in Philippine waters?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: duyong. Not the manatee, which does not live in the Philippines.

questions.text: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.hostNotes: Two pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the rest of the body.

questions.text: What is the collective noun for a group of crows?
Which Australian animal has fingerprints so similar to humans' that they could confuse a crime scene?
What is the only bird that can fly backwards?
What is the largest living rodent?
questions.hostNotes: Not the beaver, which is second largest.

questions.text: Flamingos get their pink color from what?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: food, shrimp, algae, carotenoids. Flamingo chicks are born grey or white.

questions.text: A narwhal's long tusk is actually what body part?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: canine tooth. Not a horn.

questions.text: What animal's name comes from the Greek for "river horse"?
Under its stripes, what color is a zebra's skin?
What giant marine shellfish is called "taklobo" in the Philippines?
What critically endangered white bird, called "katala", is found mainly in Palawan?
In 2011, a record-breaking crocodile named Lolong was captured in which Philippine province?
questions.hostNotes: Captured in Bunawan. Not Agusan del Norte. At about 6.17 m, Guinness listed him as the largest crocodile in captivity.

questions.text: What "living fossil" sea creature has blue blood used to test vaccines and medicines for contamination?
questions.hostNotes: Despite the name, it is more closely related to spiders and scorpions than to true crabs.

questions.text: What is the local name of the tiny mouse-deer found only in Balabac and nearby islands of Palawan?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Philippine mouse-deer, Balabac chevrotain. Pilandok is also the clever trickster of Maranao folk tales.

questions.text: What tiny goby from Lake Buhi, Camarines Sur, is among the smallest fish ever harvested commercially?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Mistichthys luzonensis. Adults are only about 1 to 1.5 cm long.
